title: Your AI agent is lying to you
hook: Your AI agent is lying to you
summary: The agent said "done". The trace said "500 error".
body: The agent said "done". The trace said "500 error".
AI agents fail quietly. A tool errors, returns nothing, or gets skipped, and the final message still sounds sure of itself.
Tracing shows every step: the prompt, the tool input, the output, the error. I use Arize Phoenix for this. It's free, open source and runs on your laptop.
Slide 6 is the 5-point checklist I run on every agent trace. Save it.

Tools:
Arize Phoenix: https://phoenix.arize.com
Phoenix on GitHub: https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix
LangGraph: https://www.langchain.com/langgraph
Comment "TRACE" and I'll DM you the checklist and the setup code.
